name: Yoruba Ifa oral knowledge and interpretation
description: Yoruba Ifa practitioners use an extensive corpus of verse and signs to interpret questions and guide individual or collective decisions.

date.basis: The cited account dates the episode; this is not a claim of global priority.

events.statement: The Ifa Group of Oyo published a documentary describing Ifa practice among Yoruba communities.
events.scope: The documentary witnesses a much older living knowledge tradition; 2004 is not its origin. The archive description, not the full film, was inspected.

evidence.supports: The UNESCO archive describes the oral corpus, diviners and applications and dates the documentary to 2004.
